label: Shaphan

text.BHSA 2KI 22:9: וַיָּבֹ֞א שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִתִּ֤יכוּ עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַנִּמְצָ֣א בַבַּ֔יִת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֗הוּ עַל־יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:9: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
text.BHSA 2KI 22:10: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖ה הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָאֵ֥הוּ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:10: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
text.BHSA 2KI 22:11: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י סֵ֣פֶר הַתֹּורָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:11: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

A.name: Shaphan
A.notes: He was sent to repair the house of the Lord (2CH 34:8)
family: scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)
grandfather-of gedaliah (Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, appointed King of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2K)

B.name: Shaphan
B.line: Secretary/scribe of King Josiah who read the found law-book to him.
family: companion-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))
scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)

why: The Hebrew names Shaphan the scribe, who received the book from Hilkiah and read it before the king, matching B’s description. However, A and B both describe Josiah’s scribe, son of Azaliah, so the stated facts do not distinguish them as separate people.
